native_mechanisms: One fold per mark in strict order, each fold's angle set by both the mark and the crease left by the previous fold (serial state-carrying chain, never skipping or looking ahead).
Press each crease against all four wire birds' beaks at once and refold until all four agree, with the spiral/snail markings deliberately scrambled so two different piles can't line up.
At the water's edge thin the whole folded wad (plus the one small suitcase) down to one small dense corner, discarding every sheet, trimmed scrap and non-holding reading.
core_technique: SipHash-2-4: four-word 64-bit ARX (add-rotate-xor) state with each message word xored in, carried through two SipRounds, xored out, then length-tagged and finalized by four rounds into one xor-folded word — with an AVX2 4-lane parallel SipHash tree (one lane per 32-byte-dealt stripe) for inputs >=256 bytes whose four lane results plus tail are re-hashed by the same serial function.
